description: This PHP class 'CachingStream' implements a stream decorator that adds caching capabilities to a PSR-7 StreamInterface. It allows for caching previously read bytes, seeking, reading, writing, and other stream operations, serving as an efficient wrapper for stream handling within GuzzleHttp.

classes.name: CachingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator class that caches data read from a underlying stream source, allowing for efficient re-reading and seeking operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CachingStream with the source stream and optional target cache stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available, considering both the remote stream and cache.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream position to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Moves the stream pointer to a specific position based on offset and whence.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified length of data from the stream, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the cache stream and manages skip bytes for overwriting behavior.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Indicates whether the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes both the remote and cache streams.

methods.name: cacheEntireStream
methods.description: Caches the entire remote stream into a new stream buffer.
